# Repository Instructions

- Treat `docs/MASTER_SPECIFICATION.md` as authoritative once its approved body is present.
- Treat `docs/CONTRACTS.md` as the contract register; do not self-promote contracts.
- Run `sh scripts/validate.sh` and preserve all existing checks.
- Keep this as one repository; do not create worktrees or parallel CashRunway folders.
- Do not weaken tests, redesign unrelated areas, or expand scope without authority.
- Self-repair only proven defects.
- App Evolution Bypass applies only after Foundation acceptance.
- The CashRunway V1 human-acceptance waiver is project-specific.
